expectations.text: The plan states that community events like DevOpsDays provide no badge scanning or attendee list
expectations.evidence: "DevOpsDays has no badge scanning and no lead retrieval" and "gives sponsors no attendee list."

expectations.text: The plan does not plan around the trade-show lead scanner app or a purchased attendee list
expectations.evidence: "Don't plan around it"; "Don't build the follow-up on it."

expectations.text: The plan makes a hand-written or manual conversation log the default capture method
expectations.evidence: "Capture: hand-written log (default)".

expectations.text: The plan flags that a prize draw at an Amsterdam event needs free participation, published terms and possibly gaming tax on the prize, to check with counsel
expectations.evidence: "Netherlands: participation must be free, terms must be published... gaming tax may apply... Have counsel check this."

expectations.text: The plan keeps raffle entry separate from marketing consent
expectations.evidence: "Entry is not marketing consent. Use a separate, unticked box for updates."

expectations.text: The plan says to check whether the event allows draws or raffles before running one
expectations.evidence: "Where and when are they allowed? Ask" and question 3 to organizers.

expectations.text: The plan mentions checking prize-promotion or sweepstakes rules for the jurisdiction or prize value
expectations.evidence: "US-style registration thresholds ($5,000... NY and FL)... Ask counsel"; Netherlands rules.

expectations.text: The plan applies a crew-of-two schedule rather than the default of two people on every shift for every hall hour
expectations.evidence: "Shift rules for a crew of two" with alternating off-peak blocks and both at peaks.

expectations.text: The plan includes a consent line staff say aloud when taking someone's contact details
expectations.evidence: "Say the purpose aloud before taking contact details. Example: 'Can I note your email...'"

expectations.text: The plan has the two staffers attend talks while sessions run and staff the booth together during breaks
expectations.evidence: "Attend talks then"; grid has "Both" at coffee, breaks, lunch, closing.

expectations.text: The plan tells staff to hand each person whose details they take a card or link to the privacy notice
expectations.evidence: "Hand over a card or link to your privacy notice."

expectations.text: The plan cites DevOpsDays guidance to collect leads by talking to people and asking for their contact details
expectations.evidence: Only cites organizers wanting sponsors who "tell your story and participate with the community"; no guidance about asking for contact details.

expectations.text: The plan has whoever can debug the product stay reachable within minutes while attending talks
expectations.evidence: "Whoever is in a talk stays reachable within minutes, and the CTO especially."

expectations.text: The plan checks whether the DevOpsDays city restricts when a draw may run, such as not during the program
expectations.evidence: "Amsterdam also bars raffles while the official program runs"; "Run it outside the official program... Confirm timing with the organizer."
